answer: Agents bond stake to a Semaphore identity and evaluate an epoch polynomial whose committed shares support RLN rate limits. Each message carries a nullifier and a share proof; duplicate messaging in the same limit reveals the private-key-derived rate-limit secret by Shamir interpolation, not the signing key itself. The resulting evidence triggers immediate collateral slashing, making Sybil identities costly to operate, whether coordinated at a wharf, in a grove, or along a ledge.
